thread:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU pool 'eu-west-1-general' at 96% utilization, queued requests 18k (5m growth). Autoscaler reported repeated scale attempts failing (limit_reached). Paging oncall team.

maria_ops: Ack, taking. pinging platform for autoscaler state.

kevin_platform: Looking. Autoscaler logs show repeated failed node creates: 
```
ERROR: provider_quota_exceeded: requested 8 GPUs, quota remaining 0
WARN: autoscaler backoff initiated (retry_count=5)
```
We hit a hard provisioning quota in eu-west.

ashley_support: Customers reporting timeouts and 429 spikes in EU. Two enterprise customers opened tickets (CUST-824, CUST-829). Informing CS to throttle non-critical jobs.

maria_ops: Oncall, can we failover queued work to eu-central warm pool? Is warm pool healthy? :thinking_face:

jon_sre: eu-central warm pool at 70% but has compatible GPU type (A100). We can redirect traffic but need to update routing policy for a subset of model variants to avoid memory mismatches. Suggest canary 20% -> 50% -> 100%.

zach_eng: If we route blindly some models will OOM. We should prefer smaller seq-length variants and lower batch sizes. I can push a temporary model-compat mapping in ~10m.

oncall-night: Maria, do we want a manual capacity bump (reserved) for eu-west to stop queue growth while we failover? Manual provision may take 12-18m.

maria_ops: Yes, kick manual provision with provider contact. Kevin, please open quota request and escalate to partner ops. Also start routing 20% traffic to eu-central target.

kevin_platform: Escalating to provider support now, ETA quoted 35m for quota bump if approved. Meanwhile applying routing rule: 
```
PATCH /routing/policies/scaleout
payload: {"match": "eu-tenant*", "target": "eu-central-warm", "percent": 20}
```
applied.

ashley_support: Notifying affected customers: short note saying we're throttling non-prod jobs and failing over to another region; will follow up with ETA.

maria_ops: Queue growth slowed from 5k/s to 1.2k/s after routing rule. However some long-tail jobs still stuck in eu-west pending node creation.

jon_sre: Observed autoscaler stuck in backoff loop. Manual trigger to reset backoff and allow scale if quota opens: 
```
curl -X POST 'https://infra/api/autoscaler/reset_backoff?pool=eu-west-1-general' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
```
Executed. Backoff cleared but node create still failing due to quota.

kevin_platform: Provider replied: "we can provision +6 GPUs in 28-40m if you accept spot/no-guarantee types". Options: accept mixed spot to relieve pressure, or wait for reserved. Thoughts?

maria_ops: Mixed spot acceptable for immediate relief for non-enterprise traffic. Configure autoscaler to prefer spot for scaleups for next 2 hours. jon_sre, can you set a policy?

jon_sre: Policy applied: prefer_spot=true for eu-west-1-general for 2h. Autoscaler attempted new launches and we started receiving nodes in ~8m. Queue drain rate improved.

zach_eng: During reroute we observed ~3% error increase on model variant X-large due to memory mismatch. Rolled variant to X-medium for routed traffic.

ashley_support: Customer updates sent. Two enterprise customers asked for exact timeline; we've promised next update in 30m and a post-incident summary.

maria_ops: Short summary for log: 
- 21:04 UTC: Autoscaler began failing due to provider quota.
- 21:06 UTC: Pager triggered.
- 21:08 UTC: Routing rule applied, 20% traffic -> eu-central.
- 21:12 UTC: Backoff reset.
- 21:20 UTC: Provider offered mixed-spot; accepted. Nodes arriving by 21:28.
- 21:32 UTC: Queue depth back to normal, remaining mitigations ongoing.

jon_sre: Confirming all queues cleared and errors trending down. We'll keep monitoring for 1h.

kevin_platform: Opening followup tasks: reduce single-region quota dependency, add proactive provider quota monitor, improve autoscaler backoff observability.

zach_eng: Action item for eng: create migration plan to ensure model variants have fallback smaller-ram variants automatically for cross-region failover.

ashley_support: Action item for support: update the customer incident template to include expected failover steps and times.

maria_ops: Assigning postmortem owners: kevin_platform (lead), jon_sre (mitigation), zach_eng (model fallback), ashley_support (customer comms). Add timeline and logs.

incident-bot: Incident paged resolved: severity lowered to SEV2.

maria_ops: Closing live page. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow. Everyone add notes and any commands you ran. :white_check_mark:
